features.description: Agentic CLI for questions, coding, and GitHub work; interactive TUI plus programmatic `-p`/`--prompt` mode on Linux, macOS, and Windows (PowerShell/WSL).
Shift+Tab mode where Copilot asks clarifying questions and builds a structured implementation plan before writing any code.
Read-only operations run automatically; destructive shell commands, file edits, and URL fetches require approval, grantable once or for the whole session (persisted permissions).
`--allow-tool 'shell(git)'` and `--allow-all-tools` skip manual approval for programmatic runs.
Prompts you to confirm you trust a folder before Copilot may read, modify, or execute files in it; choices are rememberable per folder.
`/sandbox enable` restricts Copilot's filesystem, network, and system access within a session.
Run an entire Copilot CLI session in an isolated cloud environment.
Works with your repositories, issues, and pull requests in natural language under your GitHub account, e.g. making changes and creating a pull request.
Documented use cases for driving a browser and full computer use from the CLI.
Copilot CLI can be used via the Agent Client Protocol from supporting editors.
Copilot's supported models with 1M-token extended context and configurable reasoning levels in the CLI; Auto model selection with GPT-5.3-Codex as the long-term-support fallback.
Auto-discovers local Ollama models, supports manually configured BYOK providers, and can install MAI Code 1.1 Flash locally on Windows.
Ships with GitHub's MCP server by default and supports custom MCP servers for extra tools.
SKILL.md folders of instructions, scripts, and resources loaded when relevant, at project or user level.
User-level ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md, modular *.instructions.md files, and repo .github/copilot-instructions.md; `copilot init` scaffolds repo instructions.
Add language servers for precise navigation, find-references, and renames.
Dictate prompts with speech-to-text that runs entirely on your machine; audio is never sent over the network.
`copilot config`, `copilot init`, `copilot completion`, `/login` and other slash commands, plus a documented command and shortcut reference.
`copilot app` opens the GitHub Copilot desktop app in the current directory.
Organization admins enable or disable Copilot CLI via policy settings.
Available with all Copilot plans (the Free plan supports the CLI with limited usage); usage metered via GitHub AI Credits on Pro ($10/mo), Pro+ ($39/mo), and Max ($100/mo) plans.
